Imari Samuels Extends Dundee Contract Until 2029

01 Nov 2026, 08:03 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.bbc.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysDefender Imari Samuels has signed a new contract extension with Dundee, keeping him at the club until the summer of 2029. According to reports, the agreement includes an option for an additional year.

Dundee Secures Long-Term Future of Defender

Defender Imari Samuels has signed a new contract extension with Dundee, keeping him at the club until the summer of 2029. According to reports, the agreement includes an option for an additional year.

Since joining the Dark Blues from Brighton in January 2025, the 23-year-old has made 49 appearances across competitions.

Manager Praise and Development

Dundee manager Steven Pressley expressed strong support for the player following the announcement, describing Samuels as a vital member of the squad.

  • Manager's Assessment: Pressley highlighted the defender's bravery, growing confidence, and consistent performances, noting that the player's contributions often fly under the radar.
  • Future Potential: The club coaching staff believes further development lies ahead for the young defender.

Overcoming Early Setbacks

Samuels experienced an injury-disrupted start to the current campaign, which delayed his pre-season objectives. However, reports confirm he has returned to regular first-team action and established a consistent presence in the lineup.

  • Player Reaction: Samuels stated he is eager to kick on following the finalized agreement.
  • Recovery Drive: The defender noted that missing early matches created strong motivation to reclaim his spot in the team.

Verification and Next Steps

Readers wishing to verify details regarding the contract announcement can consult official club announcements on the official Dundee FC website or check updates via BBC Sport Scotland.
